generation.intensityMethod: Deterministically thin routine non-injected events below 1.0 or add deterministic same-action copies above 1.0; all injected ground-truth events and labels remain unchanged.
generation.addedRareUnseenProbe: In holdout, six actual rare action ANOMALY_STATUS_CHANGED events plus six SYNTHETIC_PREVIOUSLY_UNSEEN_ACTION events over two hours, labeled benign.

scenarioDefinitions.name: BENIGN_RARE_AND_UNSEEN_ACTIONS

scenarioDefinitions.name: NORMAL_ACTIVITY

B_DETAILED_AUTH.role: Secondary comparison; interpret primarily for LOGIN_FAILED.

grouping.C_DETAILED_ACTIONS: Not evaluated in this independent validation.

methodology.thresholdSelection: P95 of sufficient calibration-only windows pooled across new seeds, separately by intensity, grouping and configuration; P99 recorded for comparison.
methodology.noFutureLeakage: Replay computes each baseline before its current window. Calibration current windows end before the 70/30 split; holdout windows start at/after the split. No holdout scores determine thresholds.
methodology.overlapHandling: Current windows are stepped by their own duration and passed through non-overlap selection per user; shared-boundary events are not double-counted.
methodology.insufficientWindows: Counted separately for calibration and holdout; excluded from thresholds and confusion metrics.
methodology.holdoutExceedanceRateNote: Includes known positive synthetic episodes; FPR uses benign-labeled holdout windows only.
methodology.intensityGroundTruth: Only routine activity is scaled. Injected episodes, episode times and labels are preserved; the rare/unseen benign probe is identical at each intensity.

limits: Every event and metric is synthetic; this report does not establish production detection quality.
Four new seeds improve coverage but remain samples from one deterministic generator design.
Routine activity scaling is a controlled thinning/copying experiment, not a model of every real traffic increase.
Non-overlapping windows from the same user can remain statistically correlated.
No real historical data, database, worker, incidents, rules, risk score or severity were accessed or changed.
